title: A course pack's budget puzzle (courses/<id>/puzzles/<name>.json)
description: Spend a purse on the right-sized choice for each job (Copilot app only: the Model Market). The economy is market.json; this file is its words. A puzzle the course runs has its mechanic's fields; a `"disabled": true` file needs none. Every puzzle file has an `id`, its `mechanic`, and may set `disabled` (the site stays as scenery), `text` (its words by key, `{name}` filled in by the game) and `lines` (its voice line ids by what they're for). docs/specs/COURSE-PACKS.md §4.

quest.description: The quest the puzzle plays in (a quest of this course): the steps its mechanic sets and waits on (PUZZLE_STEPS, src/course/puzzles.ts) are that quest's.

steps.description: The mechanic's steps (PUZZLE_STEPS) that the quest calls something else: game step → the quest's step.

page.description: The Logbook page filed once every job's done right-sized.

disabled.description: The course turns this puzzle off: its site stays as scenery and its cue does nothing.

text.description: The puzzle's words by key (labels, hints, readouts, signs).

lines.description: Voice line ids (voice/lines.json) by what they're for.

lesson.description: The course's model lesson and the market. `taught`: every stall grades from then on (before it, its keeper says their `early` line and the work order stays shut). `practice`: while it holds, the quest's stall (Gilda's) runs the lesson's practice (a quick look right-sized, then a hard job and a Retry of it), staking you the starfish. `practiced`: the steps it sets when the practice is done.

taught.description: Quest ids (this course's) and the step each must be at (a step, null for not started, a list of either, or {"not": …}), as in a beat's `when`.

practice.description: Quest ids (this course's) and the step each must be at (a step, null for not started, a list of either, or {"not": …}), as in a beat's `when`.

practiced.description: Quest id → the step it's set to once the practice is done.
